name: INCKEN
recent: 公司于2026年10月7日完成向MKH Berhad旗下Serentak Maju Corporation Sdn. Bhd.出售位于Bangi、面积约6.0323公顷的永久地契土地，现金代价为RM42,205,000。2026年9月至10月期间，多名董事在提名委员会、薪酬委员会、审计委员会及董事会层面出现人事变动。公司于2026年11月27日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度的合并业绩。
notable: 完成以RM42,205,000向MKH Berhad旗下Serentak Maju Corporation Sdn. Bhd.出售位于Bangi的永久地契土地。
2026年9月至10月期间，Datuk Che Md Nawawi Bin Ismail及Encik Yazid Bin Mohammad出现董事会及委员会职务变动。

recent_en: The company completed the disposal of approximately 6.0323 hectares of freehold land in Bangi to Serentak Maju Corporation Sdn. Bhd., a wholly-owned subsidiary of MKH Berhad, for a cash consideration of RM42,205,000 on 7 October 2026. Between September and October 2026, there were several board and board committee changes involving directors. The company announced its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 27 November 2026.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of freehold land in Bangi to Serentak Maju Corporation Sdn. Bhd., a wholly-owned subsidiary of MKH Berhad, for RM42,205,000.
Board and committee changes involving Datuk Che Md Nawawi Bin Ismail and Encik Yazid Bin Mohammad occurred between September and October 2026.
